_notes: Thresholds in thousands of tokens. Keys missing here fall back to the defaults in context.py.

usd_per_window_percent: API-equivalent USD per 1% of the 5-hour usage window. 5.0 is an example placeholder, not a measurement. Measure it on your plan: one turn's cost from the gauge / the % that turn used.
usd_per_weekly_percent: the same per 1% of the weekly limit. 20.0 is an example placeholder. Replace it with the calibration line that --record-usage prints.
block: pause the first message after a break of idle_min minutes once the context is >= min_context_k. A second message always passes. Slash commands never pause.

auto_continue: regexes (case-insensitive) for the app's automatic message after a limit reset. Such a message is never paused (nobody may be there to run /compact). Claude gets a note to keep the context lean instead.
quota: the hook notes the estimate from note_at_pct. The watcher exits at watch_trigger_pct or after watch_max_min minutes.
